values.note: Full service (power, water, sewer) C$45 a night plus a mandatory C$7 nightly fire permit fee (C$52 in all); the fee includes firewood and the washrooms and showers. No-service overflow area C$29 plus the fire permit. C$5 online reservation fee per booking. Dump station C$5 for non-campers. Cancellation: full refund 72 hours or more before 2 pm on arrival day, one night forfeited at 48-72 hours, two nights at 24-48 hours, nothing under 24 hours.

fees.source: County of Grande Prairie Hythe Municipal Campground page https://www.countygp.ab.ca/parks-recreation-community/campgrounds-parks-trails-and-playgrounds/hythe-municipal-campground/ (read 2026-11-10): 'A $7 nightly fire permit fee will be in place at all County campgrounds'; '$45 / night for full service (power, water, sewer) plus $7 fire permit fee / night. $5 online reservation fee / booking'; '$29 / night for no service overflow area plus $7 fire permit fee / night'; '$5 for non-campers using the dump station'; 'Camping fees include firewood and use of the public washrooms and showers.'
